title: Te Taumahatanga o tētahi Koha i Whakakahoretia
intro: I te tīmatanga o te hītori o te tangata, i te wā e tamariki ana te whenua, ā, i te wā e manawa ana te ao, ka tū tetahi wairua ki te aroaro o te Kaihanga me tētahi whakahere whakaiti. I paunatia taua whakahere ki te pauna o te manako o te Atua - ā, i kitea he hapa. Ko te mea i muri mai ehara i te kōrero mō te murunga hara, engari mō te ngākau kua pau i te hae, e ārahi ana ki tētahi mahi e kore e taea te whakakore ka haruru tonu i ngā wā katoa. Koinei te kōrero mō tētahi tangata i noho ko tōna ingoa hei kupu whakarite mō te hē nui tuatahi i mahia.
clues: I whānau mai ahau hei tētahi o ngā tamariki matamua rawa atu i whānau mai, i whānau mai i tētahi mātua e mōhiotia paitia ana e koe tōna kōrero.
I patua e au tētahi patunga tapu ki a Allah i mua, engari kāore i manakohia e au - ahakoa i manakohia te whakahere a tōku tuakana/teina me te atawhai.
Ka tipu ake te hae me te riri i roto i tōku ngākau, ā, ka whakatuma ahau ki te whakamate i te ora o ōku whanaunga.
I whakatūpato mai tōku tuakana/teina kia wehi i a Allah, engari kāore tōku whakapehapeha i pai kia whakarongo ahau.
I roto i tētahi wā ngoikore rawa, ka mahia e au tētahi mahi tino kino ki tōku ake teina.
I muri iho, kāore au i mōhio me pēhea te huna i taku i mea ai — tae noa ki te tonoa mai o tētahi mea hanga o te whenua hei whakaako i ahau.

He waipuke nui i toremi ai te iwi katoa
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi ora
He kamera uwha i puta mai i te maunga toka
He torona whakahīhī e haria ana e ngā hau kaha
location.answer: He rākau i tonoa e Allah hei whakaatu i te tanumanga

outcome.label: Hua
options: I tino pouri, i taumaha hoki i te hara tuatahi i mahia
I murua ngā hara e Allah, ā, i tukuna ki a ia te Pararaiha mutungakore
I whakaarahia ki te tūranga teitei o te poropititanga me te whakaaro nui
I whakaorangia e te aroha o te Atua i muri i tana karanga mai i te hohonutanga o te pōuri
I tukuna ki a ia te mana whakahaere i ngā jinn, i te hau, me ngā moana
outcome.answer: I tino pouri, i taumaha hoki i te hara tuatahi i mahia

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
